card.title: Research grant
card.question: Approve this research grant?
card.body_md:
## Let this room look things up in OpenAlex?

OpenAlex is a public index of scholarly papers. A grant lets the room send short search strings there. It covers fetching only; filing still asks each time.

- Provider: openalex; fallback: none (if it is down, the run says so and stops)
- What is searched: OpenAlex titles, abstracts and metadata; nothing else leaves the room
- Search shapes allowed (by template id): whitespace-gap/v1: ws.exact, ws.synonym_cover, ws.prior_attempts, ws.absence_reason
- Caps per run: 3 searches, 5 results per search
- Throttle: 1 room-started run per hour
- Expires: 2026-11-01 (30 days from today)
- Room scope: only this room (<room_id>); it does not carry to any other room
- Policy version: drp363-grant/1
- Revoke: tell Larry "revoke the research grant" at any time; the next search stops

A grant never files anything. Anything worth keeping comes back as its own yes or no.
